truth_mapping.pass: explicit case/mode pass only; feature pass requires all applicable cases explicitly pass and required evidence/gates satisfied
truth_mapping.partial: explicit partial, or aggregate includes both pass and unresolved criteria
truth_mapping.fail: explicit fail; linked defect lifecycle state does not imply or erase this result
truth_mapping.defects: closed/fixed describe defect lifecycle; never translate to case pass
truth_mapping.feature_cells: derived convenience rollups only; ignore as evidence whenever case-level results exist; regenerate from cases

drift.inventory_modes_vs_cases: top-level modes lists guest only, but cases cover guest/member/admin
drift.stale_or_unreliable_cells: feature cells contain pass/fail/retest values inconsistent with the predominantly unverified case records; never use them to claim product pass
drift.coverage: 426 controls currently have no control_ids reference from any case
drift.surface_grouping: user-facing grouping follows feature.surface; 169 features share generic Tools / registered executor, obscuring distinct named tool cases. Actual sidepanel tab navigation is EXT-F-1001 (Navigation / shell), separate from browser-tab tool features.

limitations: Source metadata audit only; did not inspect runtime behavior or prove evidence files are authentic/current.
Counts are a snapshot of inventory.json and defect JSON files at audit time.
